description: the receptionist: conversation, routing, and the dashboard's front door
notes: Served by Groq, not Claude. The 120b: both gpt-oss sizes share one 8000-tokens-per-minute bucket, so the smaller model buys no headroom and turn size, not model choice, decides whether the next turn goes through -- see roles.TOYOTA_CHAT_MODEL and profiles.ReceptionistProfile.recall_max_chars. --model on receptionist_team.main overrides this; the model field here is the documented default, not a second source of truth. max_turns 1 and no tools because she is text-only chat: delegated work runs as its own agent folder.
